_doc: The accounts the team works now (PLN Social Strategy 2027, section 3, as amended by the founders on 2026-10-22). worked: drafts are made and the run sheet proposes posts (when connected). bridge: WPL keeps one final post to Putt Tour, then parks. mirrored: automatic copies once mirroring is built, no drafts of their own. Every other account is parked: no drafts, no posts, logins kept. removed: blocked in the agent (the accounts themselves are not touched). Set PLN_FOCUS_DISABLED=1 to draft for every account.
removed_reason: removed from the agent by the 2027 social strategy (SlapFIGHT separation; @ezz.abde is a creator's account)
curated_reason: PREDCT (PLN Picks until the page is renamed): drafts only from moments a person picks in the PREDCT curation queue (config/predct.json).
